explication: TorchGeo is a PyTorch domain library for geospatial machine learning. The principal workflow composes georeferenced imagery and labels, samples geographic patches, batches samples through a data module, and supplies them to a training task. Its broader capabilities include benchmark datasets, transforms, model architectures and pretrained weights, self-supervised learning, and prediction output. The README documents the user workflow; sampled source confirms dataset, sampler, and data-module responsibilities. Several model and task implementations are represented from the source index, so their internal connections are not asserted.
